claimText: Flight path monitoring using an ATS surveillance system shall not be terminated until visual separation is applied (provided procedures ensure that both controllers are advised whenever visual separation is applied) or the aircraft has landed, or in case of a missed approach, is at least 1.9 km (1.0 NM) beyond the departure end of the runway and adequate separation with any other traffic is established.
rationale: Attempt 1 bundled the termination conditions. Attempts 2 and 3 split them. Bundling is preferred because the 'until' clause defines a single continuous obligation with multiple valid exit states. Splitting risks implying separate obligations rather than alternative conditions for one.
exactSourceQuotes: Flight path monitoring using an ATS surveillance system shall not be terminated until:
visual separation is applied, provided procedures ensure that both controllers are advised whenever visual separation is applied;
the aircraft has landed, or in case of a missed approach, is at least 1.9 km (1.0 NM) beyond the departure end of the runway and adequate separation with any other traffic is established.
